entities.summary: Bradley Alexander Pinion is an American professional football punter and kickoff specialist for the Miami Dolphins of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Clemson Tigers and was selected by the San Francisco 49ers in the fifth round of the 2015 NFL draft. Pinion has also played for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
